INTEGRATED SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrical Energy? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrical Energy.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Electrical Energy.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrical Energy.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrical Energy.

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

4. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Acids, Bases and Indicators? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Acids, Bases and Indicators.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laboratory apparatus and instruments? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Laboratory apparatus and instruments.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mixtures? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Mixtures.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mixtures.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mixtures.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mixtures.

8. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Integrated Science? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Integrated Science.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Integrated Science.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Integrated Science.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Integrated Science.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Magnetism? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Magnetism.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Magnetism.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Magnetism.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Magnetism.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Reproductive System? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Reproductive System.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Reproductive System.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Human Reproductive System.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Reproductive System.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Integrated Science and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Laboratory Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Laboratory apparatus and instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Mixtures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

2. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrical Energy.

3. A — Glucose and oxygen

4. C — Producers

5. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Acids, Bases and Indicators.

6. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laboratory apparatus and instruments.

7. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mixtures.

8. B — newton (N)

9. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Integrated Science.

10. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Magnetism.

11. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Reproductive System.

12. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.
